title: Applicability of parking regulations for large-scale residential developments within the Long Island City area
previewText: The provisions of this Chapter shall not apply to large-scale residential developments utilizing Sections 78-41 (Location of Accessory Parking Spaces) or 78-42 (Parking Regulations for Commercial and Community Facility Uses).
